objects.name: The Reader's Bay
objects.vInscr: A lectern, a book, one page turned. The hand is yours. Do not read on.

objects.name: Chalked Waystone
objects.vInscr: Kindled by pilgrims. Touch it, and every lit waystone on the Hide knows your step.

landmarks.name: The Font of the Unsaid Mother
landmarks.inscription: Her priests drained themselves into it one by one, and still it is not full. Kneel, and it will take a little of you too.

landmarks.name: The Saint of the Many
landmarks.inscription: She asked that no one be buried alone. They came to her by the thousand, and she has not been alone since.
